local_recalibration.note: Professor-compatible per-class logistic recalibration on logit(p), fit only on the local 20% calibration subset and evaluated only on the held-out 80%.

methodological_notes.separation: Alpha 4 analyses are sensitivity/adaptation/clinical-utility analyses. They must never replace or overwrite Alpha 3 raw external validation results.
methodological_notes.reverse_validation: Reverse validation trains new sensitivity models and does not alter the frozen MIMIC primary model.
methodological_notes.recalibration: Local outcome labels are used only within the 20% calibration subset. Report raw held-out and recalibrated held-out results side-by-side.
methodological_notes.subgroups: eICU-alt reproduces the professor subgroup definitions; extension to the other external datasets is exploratory and must be labelled as such.
methodological_notes.hospital_heterogeneity: Hospital-level meta-analysis is restricted to eICU-alt because hospital identifiers are available there and the professor protocol specifies this analysis.
